policy: This register distinguishes an open SPECIFIED design from a preregistered FROZEN instrument: SPECIFIED means mutable design only, with no freeze, authorization, or evidential verdict. A completed positive verdict can support an observation-ledger rung only when the committed receipts satisfy the frozen decision rule and the ledger-control lineage explicitly selects it. Each ledger control declares the exact row-status consequence of a selected REPLICATED or FAILED verdict and the open premises that verdict cannot remove; a later design or incomplete run cannot overwrite either boundary. A ledger row with no decisive completed instrument carries an explicit null controller and cannot be marked attained; a later decisive verdict must be selected explicitly in the same scientific update that applies its declared ledger consequence. The register is separate from the frozen-prediction ladder, which is reserved for physical predictions against external data. Negative and control outcomes are reported with the same prominence as positive ones. Fail closed on post-hoc analyses labeled as validation, parameters revised after data, silent reruns, omitted controls, and any run whose configuration is not reproducible from committed artifacts.

ledger_controls.supersession_policy: INS-01 remains controlling after its FAILED verdict. A later instrument may supersede it only when that instrument is REPLICATED under its frozen decision rule and is then explicitly selected here. Until both conditions hold, OL-A1 remains owed.

No completed decisive instrument controls OL-C5. INS-03 is SPECIFIED design work only and cannot move the ledger row. A later decisive verdict must be selected explicitly here in the same scientific update that applies its ledger consequence.

rows.title: OL-A1 (1,3) signature replication instrument
rows.decision_rule: Pointer while SPECIFIED: the binding text is the Tier A decision rule in the specification, copied verbatim into this field at freeze time. Tier A summary: arms A1 = 16384/128/96, A2 = 65536/256/96, and C1 = 16384/128/6 with five declared replicates per arm; observables O1 threshold inertia, O2 robust inertia at relative tau 1e-3 with reference (1,2)/(1,2)/(2,1), O3 degeneracy ratio against the reference band 2e-5..4e-5, O4 cone margin and rung ratio (retained 0.5725, declared band 0.35..0.80), O5 structural diagnostics, and O6 split-half inertia concordance; verdict REPLICATED, FAILED, or INCONCLUSIVE per the frozen rule, and FAILED demotes the OL-A1 emergent rung with equal prominence. Eigenvalue caution: the archived (1,3) threshold verdict rides on one eigenvalue at relative magnitude about 3e-5 against a 1e-12 threshold; at a relative threshold of 1e-3 the robust inertia of the retained rungs is (1,2) with one degenerate direction, matching the independently measured (1,2) receipt, and a fresh seed can flip (1,3) to (2,2) with no change in physical content. Every public sentence about this instrument carries that caution.
rows.seeds_policy: One fresh seed drawn at freeze time and five declared replicate ids per arm. The held-out split is stride-structured per rung (strides 8/35/141), so train/held-out parity structure is recorded and stratified across replicates. N = 5 resolves seed fragility at the 1-in-5 level only, and the report states so. The runtime environment is single and recorded.
controls: C-SUPPORT: matched support-density control at 16384/128/6; a fired control reads as mean signature degradation plus halved cross edges.
C-ANCESTRY: ancestry-permutation null at zero extra runtime; the null destroys (1,3) on at least 4 of 5 replicates.
rows.limitations: The committed campaign retains the manifest, summary, and fifteen per-arm receipt files but no raw feature matrices or fit captures from which an independent implementation could reconstruct every observable. The simulator's validate-only mode rechecks the committed receipt fields and frozen decision rule using the producer implementation; it is not an independent observable recomputation. The pinned campaign commit is present in the sibling custody checkout and is reachable from the configured GitHub remote's main branch; remote reachability closes only the publication-custody check and does not supply the missing raw captures or an independent observable recomputation. Instrument defect found 2026-08-21: the event chart mixes an integer ancestry-depth coordinate with three spectral coordinates whose spreads differ by about three orders of magnitude (depth standard deviation 29.11 against spectral 0.043 to 0.049 on a 2,048-carrier capture), so the quadratic form was dominated by the depth direction and the spectral directions collapsed to an eigenvalue at 1.3e-05 relative magnitude; the reported signature turned on which side of the inertia cut that degenerate direction fell, which is the recorded seed fragility. Repaired in oph-physics-sim commit 017ec2a by standardize_chart and a standardize flag on the fit, which resolves every direction and makes the signature invariant under per-coordinate rescaling, with the flag defaulting to off so committed receipts replay unchanged. The repair does not restore discriminating power: against the C-ANCESTRY null the null still reproduces the data inertia in 4 of 5 permutations before and after, and the held-out cone margin is unchanged and still negative, because eigenvalue sign counts do not test attribution to ancestry structure. No repaired rerun was performed on that basis. The measurement was removed from the reader-facing papers on 2026-08-21 and is retained here as the instrument record.

rows.title: OL-A1 factorial carrier-count and support-size follow-up
rows.decision_rule: Design-stage pointer only. The mutable design envelope crosses candidate carrier counts 16,384; 65,536; 131,072; and 262,144 with candidate absolute support sizes 48; 96; and 192 at one observer count fixed at the future preregistration, provisionally 256. A later freeze must report threshold stability, continuous spectral margins, carrier-count and absolute-support-size main effects, their interaction, quantitative ancestry-destruction and synthetic-sensitivity gates, sham equivalence, and cone-margin scaling separately through one fixed estimator before applying a predeclared overall REPLICATED, FAILED, or INCONCLUSIVE rule. No component pass may overwrite a failed control or endpoint, and no component failure may erase a separately reported component pass. These values and rules remain mutable until a target-blind freeze and do not authorize execution.
rows.seeds_policy: No seed has been drawn. Before a future freeze, a target-blind prospective precision and power calculation must determine the replicate count from declared minimum effects, interval widths, multiplicity, and attrition; no fixed count is presumed sufficient. Fresh seeds form paired blocks spanning every retained factorial cell and control, with cell execution order randomized within each block, no seed redraw or optional stopping, and one recorded runtime environment. Runtime-only pilots may measure cost but may not expose signature, margin, or control outcomes.
controls: Degree-preserving ancestry rewiring must preserve carrier count, degree sequence, support counts, and one-point record marginals while breaking lineage correlations.
Depth-stratified lineage shuffling must preserve the population at every declared depth while breaking cross-depth family identity.
A sham identifier relabeling must preserve the complete ancestry graph and leave the analysis invariant.

A synthetic ancestry-sensitive statistic of known sign must pass a predeclared quantitative recovery gate through the same estimator used for the main and ancestry-destroyed cells; it has no promotion authority.
rows.limitations: This is an open SPECIFIED design, not a preregistration or authorization to run. Candidate carrier counts, absolute support sizes, fixed observer count, replicate count, statistics, and quantitative gates remain mutable until a target-blind freeze. INS-01 remains the controlling completed verdict and OL-A1 remains owed; INS-02 cannot supersede it unless a later frozen run returns REPLICATED and the ledger control explicitly selects it.

rows.title: OL-C5 static phase-fixture validator and future source-bound readout design
rows.decision_rule: The implemented v1 validator is static-only. A valid committed synthetic fixture returns STATIC_COMMITTED_FIXTURE_CONFORMANT after exact schema, digest, Hermiticity, Kraus-effect, 0 <= E_i <= I, opposite-effect complement, normalization, and expected-frequency checks. Matrix-unit trace differences are diagnostics, not trace-nonincreasing certificates. Every object claiming producer provenance returns PRODUCER_AUTHENTICATION_UNIMPLEMENTED. Neither result maps to REPLICATED or FAILED and neither changes OL-C5. A future authenticated v2 may be frozen target-blind to evaluate source production, preparation, provenance, custody, phase discrimination, PR-64 readback, controls, and PR-03 additivity; only that separate preregistration may define PASS-to-REPLICATED, FAIL-to-FAILED, and missing-producer-to-INCONCLUSIVE mappings. No numeric placeholder is bound here and this mutable design authorizes no execution.
rows.seeds_policy: No seed has been drawn. Before a future freeze, every threshold, interval construction, multiplicity family, context and effect list, excluded-input set, missing-data rule, and block count binds target-blind. A prospective precision calculation fixes the block count from declared effects, interval widths, multiplicity, and attrition. One fresh master seed then uses a frozen collision-free derivation to paired block and cell seeds, with execution order randomized within blocks, no redraw, no substitution, no optional stopping, and one recorded runtime environment. Runtime-only pilots may measure cost but may not expose preparation coordinates, outcome counts, endpoints, or control results.
controls: The v1 checker recomputes each Kraus effect, proves exact two-by-two Hermitian positive-semidefinite certificates for E_i and I-E_i, and requires I-E_i to equal the opposite declared outcome effect.
The v1 checker recomputes the matrix-unit trace-action table as a diagnostic and does not require its generally nonzero differences to vanish.
The static declared-table comparison carries no promotion authority and returns only STATIC_COMMITTED_FIXTURE_CONFORMANT for the committed synthetic fixture.

Every producer-provenance claim is rejected as PRODUCER_AUTHENTICATION_UNIMPLEMENTED until a separately frozen v2 binds an authenticated producer, raw artifacts, run configuration, outcomes, and custody.
rows.limitations: This is an unfrozen mutable design with an implemented static conformance checker, not a preregistration or an authenticated simulator instrument. The row pins no producer, custody repository, seed, freeze artifact, run, raw capture, verdict receipt, source preparation, recorded public outcome, operational readback, provenance, or custody. The v1 synthetic fixture is a transcription of committed objects and its static verdict has no scientific promotion authority. OL-C5 remains partial; PR-03, the public-readback remainder of PR-64, and PR-65 remain open, while PR-04 remains a declared consumed effect. At present, no endpoint in this design supplies the operational derivation required to remove PR-03. For any future authenticated-v2 verdict, the registered consequence contract remains: REPLICATED support_only and FAILED block_attainment; neither verdict alone attains or owes the whole ledger row. OL-C5 has no controlling instrument, and INS-03 neither supersedes INS-01 or INS-02 nor authorizes a simulator run. Any evidential freeze or execution requires a separate immutable authenticated-v2 preregistration and explicit authorization.
